title: Partner Agent System
goal: Create Partner Agent workflow with dual-mode handling for external property dealers.
result_summary: Created PartnerAgentWorkflow with two modes: HAS_PROPERTIES (routes to inventory listing) and HAS_BUYERS (collects buyer requirements for matching). PartnerAgent model in schema with phone_number PK, agency_name, partner_type, verified, commission_rate. Added getPartnerAgentPrompt() to SystemPromptService.
